scientific_integrity: Closed-form energy and exhaustive ground-state characterization proved for all integers d>=2 and all admissible couplings. Finite exact computations are supplementary. Historical originality remains provisional; no independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Classical zero-field and zero-temperature spins, each coordinate coupling strictly positive, one uniform real antipodal coupling; excludes zero coordinate weights and added interactions. Literature-priority comparison has an inaccessible weighted folded-cube spectral article and possible unindexed equivalences.
source_ids: Xu and Meng, On the Folded Hypercube and Bi-folded Hypercube, Ars Combinatoria 92 (2009), 3–9, https://combinatorialpress.com/ars-articles/volume-092-ars-articles/on-the-folded-hypercube-and-bi-folded-hypercube/
